text: Automatically reviews new pull requests once the GitHub app is installed
quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.

text: Trigger a review on demand by commenting @cubic-dev-ai review this PR, including on PRs opened before install
quote: To review a PR that was opened _before_ you installed the app, comment: `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`.

text: Ultrareview runs a deeper, longer multi-pass review with the most capable models for risky or complex changes
quote: Ultrareview is cubic's deepest review. It runs a longer, multi-pass analysis using cubic's most capable review models, and typically takes around 30 minutes.

text: Generates fixes for review findings and pushes them to the PR branch, triggered by a one-click Fix with cubic button
quote: cubic can automatically fix issues in the background. When the AI spots a problem, you can click the **Fix with cubic** button

text: Auto-fix mode fixes the issues from every review of a pull request automatically
quote: Request a targeted fix with one click, or turn on auto-fix to have cubic fix the issues from every review of a pull request.

text: Chat with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and request fixes via tags or replies
quote: Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues. You can tag `@cubic-dev-ai` directly, or reply to cubic's existing comments to continue the conversation.

text: Auto-approval lets cubic approve low-risk, issue-free PRs that meet your review policy, skipping human review
quote: Auto-approval lets you skip human review for pull requests that cubic determines are low risk and issue-free.

text: CLI reviews local changes before push and generates a prompt your coding agent can use to fix bugs
quote: The **cubic CLI** reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them.

text: MCP server lets coding agents read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage scan issues
quote: cubic's MCP server lets your coding agent read review findings, look up codebase documentation, request PR reviews, triage PR or codebase scan issues

text: Manage subscription, team seats and roles, and buy seats from your coding agent via MCP
quote: You can now ask your coding agent to check your cubic subscription, manage team seats and roles, and purchase more seats without leaving your MCP client.

text: Custom agents are review rules that enforce your organization's specific best practices across PRs
quote: Custom agents are review rules that enforce your organization's specific best practices across pull requests.

text: Adopt existing custom agents from a community library with one click
quote: You can also adopt existing agents from the community library with a single click.

text: Learns from replies to its comments and remembers what to do differently next time
quote: Reply to its comments: Type a response explaining what cubic should do differently, and it remembers for next time

text: Thumbs up/down reactions calibrate useful vs. noisy suggestions for your codebase
quote: React to suggestions: Thumbs up/down help cubic calibrate what's useful vs noise for your specific codebase

text: Learns team conventions from patterns in senior engineers' historical code reviews
quote: cubic learns your team's unwritten rules from two sources: direct feedback on its comments, and patterns extracted from your senior engineers' historical code reviews.

text: cubic.yaml in the repo root configures review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions, and custom agents
quote: `cubic.yaml` lives in the root of your repository and becomes the source of truth for AI review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions, and custom agents.

text: Org-wide config via a cubic-config repository containing a shared cubic.yaml
quote: Create a repository named `cubic-config` in your organization and add a `cubic.yaml` file to the root directory.

text: Codebase scans deploy thousands of AI agents to find bugs and vulnerabilities across the whole repository
quote: Codebase scans deploy thousands of AI agents to find bugs and vulnerabilities across your repository.

text: AI wiki indexes the codebase into searchable wikis with source links and architecture diagrams
quote: cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes your codebase and produces searchable wikis, complete with links to source code, architecture diagrams, and more.

text: Hide test files from the PR diff and file tree to focus on implementation changes
quote: Focus on implementation changes by hiding test files from the PR diff and file tree.

text: Analytics API provides PR-level data on issues flagged, issues fixed, and AI-authored code
quote: The Analytics API gives you PR-level data on how many issues were flagged, how many were fixed, how much AI code was authored, etc.

text: Skills give coding agents instructions for reviewing code, handling PR comments, and using team codebase context
quote: cubic skills give your coding agent instructions for reviewing code, handling PR comments, and using your team's codebase context.

text: AI model providers contractually commit not to train on customer code passed through their APIs
quote: Privacy & security: "No third-party model training on Customer Code — Our AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) contractually commit that code snippets and metadata passed through their APIs are not used to train or improve their und

text: SOC 2 Type 1 compliant with controls for change, access, and vulnerability management
quote: Privacy & security: "cubic is SOC 2 Type 1 compliant, demonstrating our commitment to security and trust for our customers. We maintain comprehensive controls for change management, access management, and vulnerability management."

text: Scans every PR for logic errors, style inconsistencies, and potential security vulnerabilities
quote: The AI automatically scans every pull request for a wide range of issues, including logic errors, style inconsistencies, and potential security vulnerabilities.

text: Automatically resolves review threads when the flagged issue is fixed
quote: Auto-resolve threads: Enable automatic thread resolution to close findings when the issue is fixed

text: Generates PR descriptions and summaries from code changes
quote: cubic helps your team spend less time writing PR descriptions automatically by generating clear, concise summaries.

text: Generates fixes on request using your configured coding agent provider, such as Codex or Claude Code
quote: Coding agents: Generate fixes when requested, using your configured provider

text: Install and connect cubic in Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and other coding tools
quote: Install and connect cubic in Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, or another coding tool.

text: Flex capacity buys extra reviewed-line capacity under an optional spend limit so reviews don't pause
quote: cubic buys extra reviewed-line capacity, in top-ups of the size you choose, only when a review would otherwise be paused. A monthly spend limit is optional.

text: Integrates with Jira, Linear, Asana, and Notion
quote:
Connect to Jira, Linear,  
Asana, and Notion

text: Auto-detects and uses repo context files like README, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, skills dirs, and .ai/ files
quote: cubic automatically detects and uses context files in your repository, including `README.md`, `context.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.cursorrules`, agent skills directories, and files in `.ai/` directories.

text: Cross-repo reviews check linked repositories for needed matching updates to shared APIs, schemas, and docs
quote: Cross-repo reviews help cubic catch changes that need a matching update in another repository. Link related repositories so reviews can check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work.

text: Checks whether PRs meet requirements from linked Linear, Jira, Asana, or GitHub issues
quote: cubic can automatically analyze your pull requests to see if they meet the requirements from your linked Linear, Jira, Asana, or GitHub issues.

text: Analytics dashboard covers AI coding usage, review impact (findings and fixes), and delivery speed
quote: The analytics page shows what cubic's reviews find and what your team fixes, how fast your PRs merge, and how much of your code AI writes.

text: AI coding tab shows how much merged code was AI-written and which tools and models wrote it
quote: The AI coding tab (Beta) shows how much of your merged code was written with AI tools, which tools and models wrote it

text: Delivery tab shows PR time from creation to merge and where bottlenecks appear
quote: The Delivery and effectiveness tab focuses on how quickly PRs move from creation to merge and where bottlenecks appear.

text: Group descriptions stay pinned beside the diff while scrolling, explaining the code changes
quote: Now, the group description stays beside the diff as you scroll, so you can read the code and its explanation together.

text: Role-based access control with three roles governs who can change subscription and settings
quote: cubic uses a role-based access control system to manage who can make changes to your team's subscription and settings. Every team member has one of three roles

text: Generates AI diagrams and answers questions about unfamiliar code, failing tests, or complex changes
quote: Quickly understand unfamiliar code or libraries. Get instant answers about your PR, such as explanations for failing tests or complex changes. Visualize complex systems with AI-generated diagrams.

text: AI chat answers questions about a PR while you read it, drawing on the PR and the wider codebase
quote: AI chat answers questions about a pull request while you read it. It reads the PR and the rest of your codebase.

text: Pulls Notion page context to help reviews understand requirements and write accurate PR descriptions
quote: Add page context from Notion to make AI reviews understand your requirements and generate accurate PR descriptions.

text: Pulls Confluence documentation to give reviews architectural context
quote: Pull documentation from Confluence to provide the AI with better context for code reviews, helping it understand your architecture decisions

text: Connect Datadog so agents check whether production logs confirm their findings
quote: Now you can connect Datadog, and cubic agents will check whether your production logs confirm their findings.

text: Free plan includes 20 AI reviews per month across repos in a GitHub organization
quote: The free plan includes 20 AI reviews per month, shared across repositories in your GitHub organization.

text: 7-day free trial with no credit card required
quote: 7 days free, no credit card required.
